remarks: This Geodesic Dome home is all magic. Every corner is thoughtfully designed, creating beautiful sanctuary-compound living. The primary bedroom and bathroom are on the main floor with a guest suite on the lower floor (which is currently being used as a storage space). The upper loft area features an open bedroom space, bathroom, and living room area. The kitchen features wood beams that are said to be from the pier at Pacific Ocean Park and has recently been redone with finely designed custom cabinetry.
